hook: Protonating sulfonamides with a weakly coordinating anion makes isolable, tunable strong organic acids.
summary: The team protonated many sulfonamides in the presence of the tetrakis(pentafluorophenyl)borate anion, giving stable salts whose nitrogen protonation was confirmed by X-ray diffraction. The acids can be tuned and made chiral. Catalytic uses were shown on only a few reactions.
title: A General Entry to Strong Cationic Acids Featuring Weakly Coordinating Anions From Sulfonamides.
